shape.method: finite homeoidal density; spherical control plus fixed Gauss-Legendre correction; static orientation
shape.coordinate: m²=xprime²+yprime²/p²+zprime²/q²; taper and cutoff in m

rotation.method: Direct WebGPU Float32 Plummer probe sums; Float64 azimuthal reduction; vc²=-R<ar>; squared contributions add. Halo: continuous finite Newtonian NFW density source, GPU Float32, no halo macroparticles.
rotation.qualification: Finite-N and angular-quadrature noise retained; Float32 force diagnostic, not observed particle rotation.

conditions.forceCaveat: Float32 force and accumulation roundoff must be measured; Float64 readback diagnostics do not upgrade the trajectory precision.

haloField.source: Same finite NFW mass profile and taper as models.js; Float32 effective constants/nodes recorded when GPU mode is used
haloField.interpretation: Static finite material NFW ellipsoid in Newtonian gravity; no relativistic dynamics or geometric mass source.

shape.method: finite homeoidal density; spherical control plus fixed Gauss-Legendre correction; static orientation
shape.coordinate: m²=xprime²+yprime²/p²+zprime²/q²; taper and cutoff in m

rotation.method: Direct WebGPU Float32 Plummer probe sums; Float64 azimuthal reduction; vc²=-R<ar>; squared contributions add. Halo: continuous finite Newtonian NFW density source, GPU Float32, no halo macroparticles.
rotation.qualification: Finite-N and angular-quadrature noise retained; Float32 force diagnostic, not observed particle rotation.

fine.qualification: Same spherical-reference Jeans baryons; no re-equilibration for the new halo. Sampled extrema only; finite-N test, not a stable-DF certificate.

qualification: Exploratory shapes (.8, 1.25, .85/.7) are controlled hypotheses, not observed Milky Way axis measurements. No fixed percentage is used to declare equilibrium.
